PHASE.NAME: RTK FD Redirect Rewrite Parity
PHASE.GOAL: Extend shell-aware Synapse rewrite to preserve safe fd-merge redirects such as 2>&1 while continuing to reject file redirections and complex shell syntax.

STEPS.step-1: Parsed and rendered trailing fd-merge redirect tokens without feeding them to CommandRouter.
STEPS.step-2: Verified OpenCode hook delegation receives fd-redirect behavior through syn rewrite only.
STEPS.step-3: Added CLI regression coverage for fd-redirect pipeline rewrite output.
